delete.summary: Deletes a clinic booking associated with the specified pharmacy, clinic, and event booking identifiers.
delete.description:
This action requires the caller to be authorized and associated with a valid pharmacy.  
            If the pharmacy identifier is invalid or does not match the authenticated user, the request will result in an unauthorized response. 
            If the {eventBookingId} is invalid or zero, the request will result in a bad request response.

parameters.name: clinicId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the clinic associated with the booking. Must not be an empty GUID.

parameters.name: eventBookingId
parameters.description: The unique identifier (ID) of the event booking to be removed. Must be greater than zero.
